does: The loading screen's listener of client game-state changes: on StartLoading (id 0x16) it takes the level being loaded (ls::LoadingScreenManager+0x68 LoadingLevelUniqueKey, else the current level of ecl::LevelManager) into LevelName and sets LoadingState: SYS_CC_H / SYS_CC_I -> CharacterCreation (1), SYS_Menuscreen_Camp_A / SYS_Menuscreen_Act3_B -> MultiplayerLobby (2), TUT_Avernus_C -> Tutorial (3), any other -> Level (4); on an event whose first field is 2 it sets Initial (0); on StopLoading (0x17) it resets both hint slots, VisibileHintIndex = -1 and LoadingStateInfo empty. The XAML picks the wallpaper from LevelName and LoadingState.

evidence.says: dx11 pseudo-code: memcmp with SYS_CC_H, SYS_CC_I, SYS_Menuscreen_Camp_A, SYS_Menuscreen_Act3_B, TUT_Avernus_C; reads the manager global +0x68; the macOS function gui::DCLoadingScreen::OnGameStateChanged(ecl::GameStateChangedEvent const&) at bg3_macos_x64+0x2810700 has the same tests (manager +0x60 there)
same string constants and branch shape as macOS bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x2810700
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function

the view model read from Lua (the LoadingScreen widget's DataContext) in loads of copy attacks: the first start Initial with LevelName empty; SYS_CC_I CharacterCreation; TUT_Avernus_C Tutorial; WLD_Main_A, SCL_Main_A, BGO_Main_A, CTY_Main_A, CRE_Main_A, Basic_Level_A Level; a return to the main menu kept the level being left (Tutorial/TUT_Avernus_C, Level/SCL_Main_A), never MultiplayerLobby

questions.ask: When does a load carry a SYS_Menuscreen level so that LoadingState is MultiplayerLobby? A return to the menu from a session did not.
